metadata_description: Accessibility direction para navigation, forms, motion y responsive layouts.
title: UN product que remains usable en real conditions
description: Practicora aims para keyboard acceso, readable contrast, responsive layouts y motion que respects usuario preferences.
section_1_description: Interactive controls use visible concentración states y predictable tab order.
section_2_description: Dense views reorganize para smaller screens instead de hiding essential acciones.
section_3_description: Reduced-motion preferences limit decorative movement while preserving useful state changes.
section_4_description: Accessibility es treated as ongoing product work y should ser tested con real usuarios y assistive technologies.
